briefing_title_en: Daily Briefing: Space AI, Vercel Caching and Global Risks
briefing_summary_en: This edition covers eight sections. In AI, Google’s first data-center satellite is online and running Gemma 4 in orbit, while OpenAI updated its Model Spec and expanded teen safeguards. On the developer side, Vercel merged Data Cache into Runtime Cache and extended Daemons features. Science coverage includes a new ISS solar array, Hubble observations revisiting the early-universe fog explanation, and a blood test tied to Alzheimer’s risk. Startup news includes Salesforce’s reported $375M Rune deal and Dream’s $17M a16z round. Internationally, Canada and the EU launched an “Alliance for the Future,” and DR Congo’s Ebola deaths topped 5,000. China saw new rules take effect on Nov 1 and Typhoon Yanhua stall. Finance tracks Asia tech stocks before U.S. midterms, the Binance hack and the Fed’s path; opinion covers memory latency and ParticleDB correctness.

subsections.briefing_summary: 科学家让氧原子核以接近光速对撞，重现宇宙初期的原始物质状态，并发现这种奇异物质可在更小、更低能的对撞中形成；两种实验合金在-253°C下通过重组内部结构吸收应力并保持柔性，未像同类材料那样变脆；研究人员还用2.4万个超冷原子构建隔离量子系统，使其反复膨胀和收缩，以研究时间如何在没有时钟的情况下涌现。另一项国际研究发现，简单血液检测可在症状出现前多年预测阿尔茨海默病相关认知衰退，最高风险组五年内受损概率约38%、十年内约78%。
subsections.briefing_title_en: From Primordial Matter to Alzheimer’s Early Detection: Four Research Findings
subsections.briefing_summary_en: Scientists collided oxygen nuclei at nearly light speed to recreate a primordial state of matter, finding that the exotic substance can form in smaller, lower-energy collisions than previously shown. Two experimental alloys resisted cracking at -253°C by reorganizing their internal structures to absorb stress and remain flexible. Using 24,000 ultracold atoms, researchers built an isolated quantum system that repeatedly expands and contracts to study how time emerges without a clock. A separate international study found that a simple blood test could predict Alzheimer’s-related cognitive decline years before symptoms, with the highest-risk group facing a 38% chance of impairment within five years and 78% within 10 years.
